text: Hello, everyone.Welcome to our English class.In today's lesson, we are going to review the changes of the city life and imagine the future life.Before we start our lesson, please check if you have these things, your student's book, your notebook, worksheet and pens with you.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单和笔。Are you ready?Okay, now let's start.准备好了吗?好,现在开始吧。Last lesson, Ms.Guo's students visited the first three levels of the Natural History Museum.最后一课,佳佳的学生在自然历史博物馆的第一三层目标上观看了三层目标。Now, they have come to level 4, Garden City's Story.现在,他们来到了第四层目标,花园城市的故事。The guide is telling the children that this is a chance to know about the past, the present, and the future of Garden City.指导员告诉孩子们,这是一个机会了解过去,现实,和花园城市的未来。Now, a 4D train is coming.The children will get on a 4D train to see the changes in Garden City at each stop.现在,一架4D车正在来。孩子们将在一架4D车上看到花园城市的改变。Oh, an unforgettable trip will start.Here, the children are at the first stop.Look, the guide is showing a lot of pictures about the habitation in Garden City.这里,孩子们正在第一站。看,指导员在展示了很多照片关于花园城市的故事。Suppose you are one of them.Can you talk about the habitation in the past and nowadays?You'll have one minute to get prepared.Ready?Start!猜猜看,你们是一个人吗?可以谈谈在过去的故事和现实吗?你们有一个分钟,准备好了吗?Thumbs up!Let's read Miley's description.In the past, many people lived in Longtang.It was narrow and clouded.The whole family shared with each other.The whole family shared one room.So people didn't like living there.Nowadays, people live in the apartments.Each apartment has several rooms with different functions.People in Garden City are placed with their homes.Well done Miley!I think most of you also did a good job.Now, the train has come to the second stop.Look, you can see three groups of pictures on the screen.The picture on the left in each group is about what traveling was like in Garden City in the past.The picture on the right in each group shows what traveling is like in Garden City nowadays.Please listen to a dialogue about the changes of traveling in Garden City.Write down what you hear below the pictures.Joe, look at these two pictures.The buses look like each other.But they are quite different inside.In the past, none of the buses were air-conditioned.Nowadays, most of the buses are air-conditioned.You are right.It's more enjoyable and comfortable for us to travel by bus nowadays.Look at this picture, Alice.My father used to have a bike like this one.Well, I guess you don't have one.I know you like shared bikes.Yes, in the past, most of the people used their own bikes.Nowadays, some of the people use shared bikes.It's more convenient.What's the difference between these two cars in the pictures?The blue one is an electric car.In the past, all of the cars used gasoline.Nowadays, more and more cars use electricity.I see.Nowadays, cars can be more environmentally friendly.Now, there is a new word in the dialogue.Gasoline means 汽油.Read after me.Gasoline.Again.Would you like to listen to it again?Have you finished?Let's share Jason's writing.In the past, most of the people used their own bikes.You did a good job, Jason.What about you, boys and girls?Did you do a good job, too?Now, the children are at the third stop.Here, they will know about the changes in people's taking part in sports and activities in Garden City.Take out your worksheet and finish task 2.Read the introduction carefully and complete the table on your worksheet.You will have one minute.Time's up.Daisy has sent me her table.Let's read it.In the past, people seldom did sports.They just ran on the street.Nowadays, many people are interested in sports.More people do different kinds of exercise in the park, on the sports ground, or in the gym.In the past, children played local lane games.Nowadays, they can take part in more activities like seeing 40 films, going rock climbing, and going camping.Daisy, you did a good job.I believe most of you also did a good job.From the introduction, we know that more and more people like doing sports to stay healthy.Alice and her classmates are talking about what kind of sports they often do to stay healthy.Suppose you are Alice.Make a dialogue with Kitty, Peter, or Joe about your ways and frequency of doing sports.You will have two minutes to get prepared.This is the dialogue between Alice and Kitty.What do you usually do to stay healthy, Kitty?I usually play badminton with my sister.How often do you play badminton with your sister?Three times a week.What do you usually do to stay healthy, Alice?I usually run in the playground after school.How often do you run in the playground after school?Four times a week.Well done.As we all know, doing sports is very important for us to stay healthy.Now, the train is arriving at the last stop.Here, the children will find out the changes in the environment in Garden City.Please read the information and write some suggestions on protecting the environment by using the structure BY.Richard is one of my students.He has got some ideas.Let's read them together.We can protect our environment by classifying the rubbish and putting it in different bins.We can protect our environment by not throwing rubbish into the rivers.We can provide our environment by planting more green plants.Good.Richard's suggestions are very helpful.On to them.During the train ride, Ms.Guo's students learned about the changes in Garden City from the aspects of habitation, transportation, sports and activities, and the environment.Suppose you are one of the students.Can you imagine the life in Garden City in 10 years' time?These pictures may help.Write down your imagination from at least two aspects.You will have three minutes.这就是LUCY的想象,让我们一起读一下,Garden City的未来故事。我们将在10年间,在Garden City生活得更方便和舒适。我们将看到更多车辆。我们将看到有些车在天空上飞翔。他们将让我们更快地走过去。人们在Garden City将能够在海底下生活。他们将与很多海洋动物成为朋友。多么的兴奋。我期待将在未来的Garden City见到。LUCY展示了她的想象从两个方面。车辆和居住。我相信你也做了一个很好的工作。今天,您已经知道了Garden City生活的改变。您在Garden City的自然历史卫生协会中享受了访问吗?我相信是的。在课程后,请在胸部上完成运动。本学期统一视频课结束了。后续请学校自主安排复习指导。
